---
name: curation-entry
description: Add a resource to a Ventura curation repository with provenance relevance and licensing context checked. Use when adding a new external reference to curated learning or resource lists. Do not use when copying upstream content into a Ventura project.
---

# Curation entry

- Verify the resource exists and matches the target curation theme.
- Record the canonical project or documentation link.
- Describe why it belongs without copying promotional claims.
- Distinguish reference inspiration and derived material.
- Check provenance and license obligations before including copied content.
- Avoid duplicate entries and near-duplicate categories.
- Keep ordering and formatting consistent with the target curation file.
- Validate links and repository checks after editing.
